name: billing_feature_gates
problem: Features must switch on/off by plan, and reflect upgrades/downgrades immediately.
glue: feature_gates reads entitlements derived from subscription_status; webhooks invalidate any cached entitlement on plan change.
steps: Map each plan to an entitlement set (entitlements part).
feature_gates checks entitlement_gate, which reads subscription_status.
On stripe_webhooks plan change, refresh/invalidate the cached entitlements for that user.
